The coordinator validated the output mechanically (render idempotent, 173 metadata tests OK, audit deltas +26 base units, +79 facets, +19 requirements, +6 catalogues), committed it verbatim, and explicitly instructed the reviewer to treat it with extra scepticism for unfinished or inconsistent content.

findings.defect: The S9.5.4-001 positive control offered a(:,2,1:3) as satisfying the third bullet of 9.5.4 p1. That list places the scalar subscript 2 before the 1:3 triplet, so it violates the very bullet it was meant to control.
findings.correction: The plan now uses (:,1:3,2), whose only section-subscript preceding the triplet is a colon triplet, and names (:,2,1:3) as a negative. It also requires the positive control to satisfy the other two bullets.

findings.defect: The C9SR2-001 correction kept (2,1:3) as a negative while stating that every source is rank three. On a rank-three array that list supplies only two section-subscripts, so it is already invalid under the 9.4.2 C913 rank accounting and cannot demonstrate the 9.5.4 p1 bullet it is filed under. This is the same attribution defect that blocked the preceding packet.
findings.correction: The negatives are now (:,2,1:3) and (2,:,1:3), each with three section-subscripts for the same rank-three array, and the plan states explicitly that no source is invalidated instead by C913.
findings.note: This finding was raised against a coordinator-authored correction and demonstrates that the independent review is not deferential to the integrator.

table_9_1_assessment.independently_derived_formula: subscript order value = 1 + sum over i of (s_i - j_i) * product of d_1 through d_(i-1), with d_i = max(k_i - j_i + 1, 0)
table_9_1_assessment.extraction_ambiguity: Automatic extraction interleaves the table columns, misplaces one multiplication sign in the rank-15 row and emits a stray fragment.
table_9_1_assessment.candidate_behaviour: The catalogue records the ambiguity explicitly and states the intended final term (s15 - j15) x d14 x ... x d1 rather than silently resolving it.
table_9_1_assessment.reviewer_verdict: The recorded ambiguity statement is honest and accurate, and is not covering a wrong formula.
table_9_1_assessment.subdivision: table9.1 is accounted on its own terms and subdivided per rank row.
